title.narrative: Contribution to the 7th United Nations Environment Assembly

description.narrative:
This project aims to advance an inclusive dialogue towards addressing the global planetary crises, while adopting resolutions that catalyse climate actions at the 7th United Nations Environment Assembly (UNEA-7) conference. The aim of the conference is moreover to aspire to raise global climate ambitions and drive adaptation, resilience and green transformation.
The contribution to UNEA-7 is earmarked for the participation of LDCs participation in the conference. The funding will cover the costs of economy class flight tickets and daily subsistence allowances for two delegates from each LDC.

UNEA-7, taking place in December 2025, will be a very important meeting for the global environmental agenda, but will likewise face difficulties due to the current political situation and international cutbacks on multilateral contributions and ODA. As the current President of the Council of the EU, Denmark holds a key position to highlight the continued importance of multilateral environmental governance. UNEA-7 is expected to deliver both a Ministerial Declaration, to adopt the Medium-term Strategy for 2026-2029 and to adopt a number of resolutions, proposed by Member States. To enable fruitful negotiations, prevent setbacks, and support developing countries’ participation, Denmark will use its financial support to UNEA-7 to confirm the importance of equal economic opportunity and representation in adopting global environmental policy.
